issues.claim: NUVA Smile (Piscataway Dental Group), 1315 Stelton Rd, listed as an eligible independent with no chain note
issues.problem: The practice's own locations page is titled 'Dental Offices in New Jersey | 25 Locations | NÜVA' and lists the Piscataway office alongside Fort Lee, West New York, Old Bridge, Elmwood Park and others. 25 offices under one brand exceeds the file's own stated 10-site chain threshold, so this is a branded multi-site dental group (chain) that should have been excluded.
issues.fix: Remove NUVA Smile, or keep only if the owner explicitly wants large DSO-branded groups; in that case re-state the chain rule in the caveats because it currently contradicts this entry.

issues.claim: Certified Dermatology, 242 Old New Brunswick Rd #110, note says 'small group, under the 10-site threshold used here'
issues.problem: The practice's locations directory covers about 32 offices in NJ alone (plus Pennsylvania). The note's factual claim of being under the 10-site threshold is wrong; it is a large branded multi-site dermatology group.
issues.fix: Correct the note and drop the entry as a chain (or document an explicit exception) - as written it is an excluded type that remains in the list.

issues.claim: Island Spa & Sauna, 1769 Lincoln Highway (Route 27), town field 'Edison'
issues.problem: Wrong zone. The spa is in Edison, not Piscataway; the mapper added it as a 10-mile-radius extra. The zone is 'Piscataway | groups B', and every other entry is in Piscataway township.
issues.fix: Move to the Edison zone list or delete; a zone list should not mix a different town's businesses.

issues.claim: Central Jersey Dental Arts, 1056 Stelton Rd, phone 'Unknown'
issues.problem: Phone is published on the practice's own locations page as (732) 981-1040. The entry is otherwise confirmed (address correct).

The practice site (perspectivesnj.com - home and contact pages) does not render a phone number in text, and a search-engine index of the same contact page returns (732) 743-5774 instead. One of the two numbers is wrong; I could not confirm which.
issues.fix: Call or confirm the number on the site footer/Google Business Profile before using it; mark phone as unverified until then.

issues.claim: Leonard Yee, DDS, address '36 Wills Way'
issues.problem: The practice's own site prints '36 Willis Way, Piscataway' with the same phone (732) 562-8881. Either the site has a typo or the list does; the street name differs.
issues.fix: Verify the street spelling (the Piscataway road is generally 'Wills Way') and align the entry.

issues.claim: Ambrose Animal Hospital, address field '1636 Stelton Rd Suite 312 - unconfirmed'
issues.problem: The site still renders no street address (address block is blank in the page), so the only source for the address is directory snippets. It cannot be confirmed that this hospital operates at a Piscataway street address.
issues.fix: Do not use in outreach until the address is confirmed (call, or check the location page/Google Business Profile); otherwise remove.

issues.claim: Chain-threshold calls on smaller multi-site brands (Piscataway Animal Clinic/Raritan group 4 sites, Maximum Health & Wellness 6, The Eye Center 3, New U Physical Therapy 2, Satori Academy 8+1)
issues.problem: These pass the file's 10-site rule, but two of the groups already kept are far above that rule (NUVA 25, Certified Dermatology 32), so the threshold has not been applied consistently. A reviewer cannot tell whether the owner wants branded multi-site operators in or out.
issues.fix: State one numeric rule (e.g. 'no more than 3 locations under one brand') and re-filter the whole list against it in one pass.

issues.claim: Kaizen Martial Arts, 1506 Stelton Rd, website blank
issues.problem: The school has its own site (karatepiscataway.com, includes a class-schedule page). Minor enrichment, entry itself is real.
issues.fix: Add https://karatepiscataway.com/ and a phone/address confirmation from that page.
